controlledAi.label: Model and task routing
controlledAi.detail: Each task goes to the model that fits its cost and quality need, behind one interface.

controlledAi.label: Retrieval and knowledge context
controlledAi.detail: Workflows read shared, sourced context instead of each keeping its own copy.

controlledAi.label: Agent orchestration
controlledAi.detail: Explicit steps and states, so every transition can be tested and audited.

controlledAi.label: Human decision points
controlledAi.detail: Consequential steps wait for a named person, who reviews a verified proposal.

controlledAi.label: Evidence lineage
controlledAi.detail: Every output links back to its inputs, sources and decisions.

controlledAi.label: Identity and authority
controlledAi.detail: What a person can see or do depends on role, case relationship and action class.

controlledAi.label: Integrations and systems of record
controlledAi.detail: Systems of record stay authoritative. Only governed connectors write back, after approval.

controlledAi.label: Observability
controlledAi.detail: Every action is logged, and the running system can be inspected as it works.

controlledAi.label: Evaluation and release gates
controlledAi.detail: A workload is released only when its evaluation passes defined thresholds.

execution.label: Partner model
execution.gap: Thinner: designed joint-team models and multi-party execution, but no formal partner-management role.

execution.label: Adoption and expansion
execution.gap: Thinner: adoption at programme level and in designed operating models, with no renewal or consumption targets held.

discipline.label: Requirements and acceptance tests first
discipline.portfolio: {acceptanceChecks} acceptance checks written before the build

discipline.label: Roadmap with gates
discipline.portfolio: Build sequence P0 to P5 with a gate per phase
discipline.workFabric: Three-phase plan, one gate per phase

discipline.label: Roles and ownership
discipline.portfolio: Every claim names what I personally did
discipline.workFabric: Joint team with lead, core, consulted and oversight roles

discipline.label: Architecture decisions recorded
discipline.portfolio: Decision log with a reason for every dependency

discipline.label: Accessibility
discipline.portfolio: Keyboard model, reduced motion and axe checks on every route

discipline.label: Publication audit
discipline.portfolio: Every linked repository audited; links stay hidden until approved
discipline.workFabric: Client identity removed before any reuse

discipline.label: Limitations stated
discipline.portfolio: Every case ends with its limitations and scope boundary

discipline.label: Open decisions surfaced
discipline.portfolio: What only I can confirm is listed, not assumed
discipline.workFabric: Exploratory close: no scope or funding ask

economics.context: Illustrative defaults from my AI Economics Simulator: a banking risk division of 12,000 staff, three use cases (RCSA, control testing and third-party risk), 72 users, 12 connected systems, and a platform that is 30 percent built.
economics.source: Re-implemented from the simulator formulas and checked against its default scenario. Not a client model.
